samples.text:
The chart shows how many new homes were built in four regions of a country in 2023, and it divides them into four types of property.

The South had the most new homes, with 55,000 in total. Most of them were apartments, 26,000, and there was also 14,000 detached houses, 9,000 semi-detached and 6,000 terraced houses.

The North and the East both had 29,000 homes. In the North, detached houses was the biggest type with 9,000, then apartments with 8,000, semi-detached 7,000 and terraced 5,000. The East had more detached houses, 11,000, but less apartments, only 6,000. It also built 8,000 semi-detached and 4,000 terraced houses.

The West had the smallest number of homes, 26,000. Apartments were almost half of this number with 12,000. Detached houses was 6,000, semi-detached 5,000 and terraced only 3,000, that is the lowest figure in the chart.

Overall, the South built much more homes than the other regions, and terraced houses were the least common type in every region.
samples.why: Figures accurate and every region covered · overview basic and at the end · region-by-region listing with little comparison · repetitive vocabulary · agreement, quantifier and punctuation errors that do not block meaning.

samples.text:
The chart compares the number of new homes completed in four regions of a country in 2023, broken down into detached houses, semi-detached houses, terraced houses and apartments.

Overall, the South completed far more homes than any other region, largely because of its high number of apartments. Terraced houses were the least common type of property in all four regions.

With 55,000 completions, the South built almost twice as many homes as the North or the East, which recorded 29,000 each. Apartments made up nearly half of the South's total, at 26,000, while it also lead the other regions in detached housing, with 14,000 units. In contrast, the North and East were dominated by detached houses, at 9,000 and 11,000 respectively, and had relatively few apartments (8,000 and 6,000).

The West had the lowest total, at 26,000. As in the South, apartments were the most common type there, accounting for 12,000 homes, compared to 6,000 detached and 5,000 semi-detached houses. Terraced homes made up the smallest category across the regions, ranging from only 3,000 in the West to 6,000 in the South.
samples.why: Clear overview of the leading region and least common type · key features compared across regions · logical organisation and good linking · appropriate vocabulary · one minor verb-form slip.

samples.text:
The chart provides a regional breakdown of new home completions in 2023, distinguishing between four types of property.

The South stood out as by far the most active region, completing almost as many homes as the North and East combined. Apartments were the dominant property type in the South and West, whereas detached houses were most numerous in the North and East. Terraced housing, by contrast, formed the smallest category everywhere.

A total of 55,000 homes were completed in the South, of which 26,000 were apartments, as many as in the other three regions put together. The South also led in detached houses (14,000), semi-detached houses (9,000) and terraced houses (6,000). The West, although it had the lowest overall total at 26,000, followed a broadly similar pattern, with apartments accounting for 12,000 of its new homes.

The North and East each completed 29,000 homes, but their mix was quite different. Detached houses were the largest group in both, at 9,000 and 11,000 respectively, with semi-detached homes close behind (7,000 and 8,000). Apartments were less significant, particularly in the East, where just 6,000 were built, and terraced houses numbered only 5,000 and 4,000.
samples.why: Key features skilfully selected, including accurate derived comparisons · clear overview · regions grouped logically by housing mix · cohesion well managed · precise vocabulary · wide range of error-free structures.
